The '''Naps Fral Cluster''', also known as the '''Naps Fral system''',  was located on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] that connected [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. It was the frequent stage of ambushes masterminded by the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]] who attacked [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in search of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|women]] to [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]].
